Title: Fell Asleep Scrolling, Woke Up Unable to Turn Your Head? 3 Reasons Why

Description:
Fell asleep scrolling on your phone and woke up unable to turn your head? A few daily habits might be feeding that stiffness.

Low magnesium can make tense neck and shoulder muscles harder to relax, and coffee, fast food, and alcohol can all crowd out the magnesium-rich foods your muscles need - some research has even linked more than 2 cups of coffee a day to more frequent neck and shoulder pain. Watch to see why, and simple swaps for each one.
